title: Luteolin alleviates PCOS by inhibiting AR/STAT3/NLRP3-mediated granulosa cell pyroptosis.
authors: Ouyang, Xiaoling; Tang, Hong; Yang, Yuting; Hao, Xiaobai; Jiang, Xiaomei; Zhou, Qi; Li, Linxia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究木犀草素通过AR/STAT3/NLRP3通路缓解多囊卵巢综合征颗粒细胞焦亡，属纯湿实验与药理机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), a common endocrine-metabolic disorder, is driven by hyperandrogenism and chronic low-grade inflammation that impair follicular development. Granulosa cell pyroptosis is increasingly recognized as a key pathogenic mechanism in PCOS. Luteolin (LUT), a natural flavonoid found in many traditional medicinal plants, exhibits potent anti-inflammatory properties. However, its role in regulating granulosa cell pyroptosis within the context of PCOS has not been elucidated. METHODS: We established a dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA)-induced PCOS rat model to evaluate LUT's therapeutic effects. Hormone and cytokine levels were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), while network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict molecular targets. In vitro, dihydrotestosterone (DHT)-treated KGN cells served as a model for granulosa cell dysfunction. Pyroptosis was assessed by Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8), lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release, and transmission electron microscopy. The expression and activation of androgen receptor (AR), Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 3 (STAT3), and NOD-like Receptor Pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome components were analyzed by Western blot and immunohistochemistry, with their roles confirmed using specific inhibitors. RESULTS: Luteolin (LUT) treatment alleviated hormonal imbalance and ovarian morphological abnormalities in PCOS rats. LUT suppressed STAT3 phosphorylation, pro-inflammatory cytokine expression, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation in both in vivo and in vitro models. Network pharmacology identified STAT3 as a high-affinity target of LUT (binding energy: - 8.589 kcal/mol). Mechanistically, LUT attenuated granulosa cell pyroptosis by suppressing the AR/STAT3/NLRP3 axis. CONCLUSION: Luteolin inhibits androgen-induced granulosa cell pyroptosis by targeting the AR/STAT3/NLRP3 signaling pathway. These findings provide a robust mechanistic basis for luteolin's therapeutic potential in PCOS, supporting its development as a targeted therapy for this and other inflammatory reproductive disorders.
abstract_zh: 背景：多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是一种常见的内分泌代谢性疾病，由高雄激素血症和慢性低度炎症驱动，损害卵泡发育。颗粒细胞焦亡日益被认为是PCOS中的关键致病机制。木犀草素（LUT）是一种存在于多种传统药用植物中的天然黄酮类化合物，具有强效抗炎特性。然而，其在PCOS背景下调节颗粒细胞焦亡的作用尚未阐明。方法：我们建立了脱氢表雄酮（DHEA）诱导的PCOS大鼠模型，以评估LUT的治疗效果。通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）测量激素和细胞因子水平，同时使用网络药理学和分子对接预测分子靶点。体外实验中，二氢睾酮（DHT）处理的KGN细胞作为颗粒细胞功能障碍模型。通过细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）、乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）释放和透射电子显微镜评估焦亡。通过Western blot和免疫组织化学分析雄激素受体（AR）、信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）和NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）炎症小体组分的表达和激活，并使用特异性抑制剂确认其作用。结果：木犀草素（LUT）治疗缓解了PCOS大鼠的激素失衡和卵巢形态异常。LUT在体内和体外模型中抑制了STAT3磷酸化、促炎细胞因子表达和NLRP3炎症小体激活。网络药理学将STAT3鉴定为LUT的高亲和力靶点（结合能：-8.589 kcal/mol）。机制上，LUT通过抑制AR/STAT3/NLRP3轴减轻颗粒细胞焦亡。结论：木犀草素通过靶向AR/STAT3/NLRP3信号通路抑制雄激素诱导的颗粒细胞焦亡。这些发现为木犀草素在PCOS中的治疗潜力提供了坚实的机制基础，支持其作为该疾病及其他炎症性生殖疾病靶向疗法的开发。
